title: Power BI Consumption over Semantic Models
purpose: Show reports and apps reusing semantic models across Import, DirectQuery, and Direct Lake.
accessibleSummary: Data reaches a semantic model through Import, DirectQuery, or Direct Lake. The shared model defines semantics and security. Reports and apps distribute governed analytics.
longDescription: Import copies a refreshed snapshot into memory. DirectQuery delegates requests to the source. Direct Lake reads eligible OneLake Delta and caches accessed data. These modes feed a shared semantic model. Reports consume one model and apps package approved content for audiences.
